decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 8am-8pm  nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of recycling facilities have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The recycling arrangements shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the premises hereby permitted is occupied

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the retail units shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 6 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. 619/RDP/PO2 and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 7 - Before the development commences details of cycle parking shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the spaces shown on the approved drawing shall be available for use before first occupation of any part of the development
Condition : 8 - The retail units hereby approved shall remain as independent units and shall not be enlarged without the written agreement of the Local Planning Authority
description: Change of use from car dealership to 4 X A1 retail units.
